column1: What's the most assignment deadlines and tests you've ever had in a single week?
column2: In your busiest week, about how many hours did you spend on your assignments, outside of classes?
column3: Have deadline clashes ever made you submit work that you knew wasn't your best?
column4: Have you ever found out late about a presentation, assignment or test that wasn't shown on Moodle, or that you weren't aware of?
column5: Have you ever had an assignment due before you got feedback on your previous one from the same module?
column6: We're building CrunchRadar, a tool that adds up the whole class's assignment workload for each week, warns lecturers when a week is overloaded, and suggests moving a deadline before it becomes a problem. How useful would that be for you?
column7: CrunchRadar would also send you a short email every Monday with your workload for the week and what to start now. Would you read it?
